text_block_list.text:
Claiming victory at the Kikuka Sho,
Mejiro
McQueen's dominance at
long-distance races is
indisputable.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан expresses her frustration at
their
difference in ability.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In response, McQueen tells Ryan that
she hopes
to see her best effort in the
final furlong of their
next race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With the Kikuka Sho over, our next race
is the
Arima Kinen. Мэдзиро Райан must
now prepare for a
race where many new,
strong opponents await.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
